sourceEvidence.ownerCorrection: Actual game entry was observed during a prior server experiment. Do not reduce all prior launch evidence to splash-only. Exact run-to-observation correlation remains separate from the latest Run 20 failure.

partialObservedFacts.fact: The commercial game reached the actual game after launch in at least one prior server experiment.
partialObservedFacts.boundary: This proves a real game-entry boundary was crossed, but does not by itself prove a stable long-running input playtest or runtimePass:true.

distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.lesson: If an app reaches the actual game before a later crash or compatibility failure, record both the successful game-entry boundary and the later failure boundary. Do not collapse the entire run into a statement that the game never entered.
distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Track INSTALL, LAUNCH, GAME_ENTRY, INPUT_EXERCISE, STABILITY and CRASH as separate evidence stages.

distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.lesson: Actual game entry is meaningful positive partial runtime evidence even when the full stable-play gate is not satisfied.
distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Allow directly observed launch/game-entry facts to be distilled as partial evidence while keeping full gameplay and runtime promotion blocked until stable input and survival evidence exists.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: A successful ARM64 split-APK install on an x86_64 Android guest does not prove sustained runtime compatibility. Native translation can still fail after launch or game entry in JNI/native-library or application initialization paths.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: Do not promote install or game-entry success to stable runtime success. Preserve the partial success boundary, then require process survival, foreground state and crash-free input evidence for full runtime pass.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: Large split-APK streaming installs can fail at session finalization even when transfer appears complete; no-streaming materially changed the failure boundary and allowed installation to complete.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: When a split install fails at finalization or package-service transport, test a no-streaming path before changing Android API levels or application payload assumptions.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: A native ARM64 CI host does not imply nested hardware virtualization is available to an Android ARM64 emulator.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: Probe acceleration capability before downloading or booting a large ARM64 system image; treat HV_UNSUPPORTED as an infrastructure blocker, not an app failure.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: Host architecture and guest architecture labels are insufficient. The guest must explicitly expose arm64-v8a in ro.product.cpu.abilist and a working native bridge when running ARM64 binaries on x86_64.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: Gate ARM64 split installation on observed guest ABI list and native-bridge evidence.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: On GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, native aarch64, 4K pages, Docker availability and binder/hwbinder/vndbinder devices can all be valid while Redroid userspace still fails to reach sys.boot_completed.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: Separate host-capability PASS from Android-userspace-boot PASS. Do not download proprietary APK bytes until the Android container itself reaches a verified ready state.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: Repeated failures sharing the same compatibility class should narrow the search space instead of causing random Android API cycling.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: After two or more materially similar failures, require a new hypothesis or infrastructure capability before retrying another API/image variant.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: Install PASS, game entry, process creation, or infrastructure readiness are useful staged evidence but are not individually equivalent to a verified stable playtest.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: runtimePass:true requires launch, foreground ownership, process survival, input exercise, and absence of fatal exception/ANR in the captured evidence window.

allowed: host capability versus guest readiness separation
forbiddenUntilStableRuntimePass: input-response timing distillation beyond directly captured evidence
UI interaction-flow distillation beyond directly captured game entry
